{{Quote|Anakin! I have two droid fighters on my tail and I can't shake them!|[[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], to [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]]|<ref name="The Clone Wars: The Wind Raiders of Taloraan">''[[The Clone Wars: The Wind Raiders of Taloraan]]''</ref>}}
This [[Delta-7B Aethersprite-class light interceptor/Legends|Delta-7B Aethersprite-class light interceptor]] was the personal [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] during the early days of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==History==
{{Quote|All the navigational controls have been overridden! It's like riding a ''comet''!|[[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]|<ref name="Runaway Starfighter" />}}
[[File:OWK_Delta-7B_2.png|thumb|left|180px|Kenobi's Delta-7B linked with a [[Syliure-31 hyperspace docking ring/Legends|Syluire-31 hyperspace docking ring]]]]
Obi-Wan flew alongside [[Anakin Skywalker's Delta-7B Aethersprite-class light interceptor/Legends|Anakin's Delta-7B]] in the [[Battle of Christophsis/Legends|Battle of Christophsis]]. He then piloted the craft to negotiate with [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], and fought in the [[Battle of Teth/Legends|Battle of Teth]].

Later, Obi-Wan flew the Delta-7B again with Anakin's fighter again, as they led [[Ghost Squadron]] during the [[Battle of Nexus Ortai]]. However, the Republic withdrew when, after both sides sustained heavy casualties, the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|CIS]] brought reinforcements out of [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]]. At some point during the Clone Wars, he used this ship for transport to [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]] to inspect rumors that [[Duchess/Legends|Duchess]] [[Satine Kryze/Legends|Satine Kryze]] was leading the [[New Mandalorians/Legends|New Mandalorians]] to war against the Republic.

==Behind the scenes==
[[WizKids Games|WizKids, Inc.]], before its operations were discontinued by [[Topps|The Topps Company, Inc.]], provided a sneak peak at Obi-Wan's Delta-7B as a game piece in the [[Clone Wars (PocketModels)|''Clone Wars'' expansion]].

As with [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon's]] ''[[Blade of Dorin/Legends|Blade of Dorin]]'' and [[Adi Gallia's Jedi Starfighter/Legends|Adi Gallia's Delta-7B]] along with [[Ahsoka's Delta-7B Jedi Starfighter/Legends|Ahsoka Tano's Delta-7B]] and [[Saesee Tiin's Delta-7B Aethersprite-class light interceptor/Legends|Saesee Tiin's Delta-7B]], the hull graphics design on Kenobi's ship was later reused on [[Barriss Offee's Delta-7B Aethersprite-class light interceptor/Legends|Barriss Offee's Delta-7B]] just with a different color scheme.

In an adventure path the reader may take in the story of [[The Clone Wars: Decide Your Destiny: Tethan Battle Adventure|''Tethan Battle Adventure'']], [[Sue Behrent]]'s [[2010]] entry in the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Decide Your Destiny]]'' series of choose-your-own-adventure books, Kenobi takes a [[Transport/Legends|transport]] back to the ''[[Spirit of the Republic]]'' in order to travel from [[Teth/Legends|Teth]] to Tatooine, claiming that his "fighter was badly damaged" upon his arrival on Teth. In another path, however, Kenobi uses his fighter to travel to the ''Spirit of the Republic''.<ref name="Tethan">''[[The Clone Wars: Decide Your Destiny: Tethan Battle Adventure]]''</ref>
